task.description: Implement OIDC-04 in backend code per src/design/oidc-04-standards-compliance-boundary.md. Enforce a standards-only OIDC verification boundary: discovery document endpoint resolution, JWKS key retrieval, and standard claim validation (iss, sub, aud, exp, nbf, iat) in core authentication flow. Ensure provider-specific token extensions are not required for authentication success and preserve provider-agnostic behavior outside adapter modules. Wire verifier integration points needed by API bearer auth flow without introducing adapter-specific dependencies in core verification path. Run required validations: zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, plus error-set propagation check before completion.
acceptance_criteria: OIDC-04 behavior implemented and aligned with the approved design artifact
Core auth verification depends only on discovery metadata, JWKS, and standard claim checks
Provider-specific token extensions are not required for successful authentication
zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate all pass

result.summary: Implemented OIDC-04 standards compliance boundary by introducing a provider-agnostic standards verifier (discovery document resolution, JWKS kid lookup, and standard claim checks for iss/sub/aud/exp/nbf/iat), wiring Keycloak adapter verification through that boundary, and validating standards-only token authentication without provider-specific extension claims.
